req.title: Task description optional
req.statement: The system shall accept POST /tasks/ payloads without a description field.

doc.reasoning: R-TASK-017 requires that POST /tasks/ accepts payloads without a description field. The schema shows TaskCreate inherits TaskBase where description is Optional[str] = Field(None, ...), so omitting it should yield HTTP 201 with description=null in the response. Tests cover: (1) positive EP — omit description entirely, assert 201 and null description; (2) positive EP — explicitly pass description=null, assert 201 and null description; (3) boundary BVA — omit description but use title at min-length (1 char), assert 201; (4) boundary BVA — omit description but use title at max-length (100 chars), assert 201; (5) negative NEG — omit both title and description (title is required), assert 422; (6) DT — omit description with completed=true, assert 201 and completed=true in response; (7) NEG — description exceeds 500 chars (invalid), assert 422. These cover mutation operators: constant-mutation on status codes, field-presence checks, boolean field values, and boundary ±1 on string lengths.

tests.name: test_post_task_without_description_returns_201
preconditions: Database is initialized with pre-loaded rows
actions: POST /tasks/ with payload containing only 'title' and 'completed' fields (no description key)
trace: R-TASK-017: system shall accept POST /tasks/ payloads without a description field
tests.executable:
import os, sys
os.environ.setdefault('DATABASE_URL', 'sqlite://')
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app
from app.database import Base, engine
Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)
client = TestClient(app)

def test_post_task_without_description_returns_201():
    payload = {"title": "Run unit tests", "completed": False}
    r = client.post("/tasks/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 201
    body = r.json()
    assert body["title"] == "Run unit tests"
    assert body["description"] is None
    assert body["completed"] == False
    assert isinstance(body["id"], int)

test_post_task_without_description_returns_201()

import os
os.environ.setdefault('DATABASE_URL', 'sqlite://')

from app.main import app
from app.database import Base, engine
Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)
client = TestClient(app)

def test_post_task_without_description_response_fields_complete():
    payload = {"title": "Organize desk"}
    r = client.post("/tasks/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 201
    body = r.json()
    assert set(["id", "title", "description", "completed", "created_at"]).issubset(body.keys())

    assert body["completed"] == False
